scope.statement: Reduced bookkeeping network only; this is not a genome-scale model (GEM) and is not an empirical reconstruction. Substrates are glucose-equivalent monomer concentrations, never literal polymer molarity.

design_rationale.routing: Each substrate route converts 1.0 glucose-equivalent input into 1.0 biomass-precursor unit for transparent mass-balance inspection.
design_rationale.acetate_coupling: Each route also creates 0.25 acetate-bookkeeping units as an Own model choice that makes the analytical byproduct output explicit; it is not empirical.
design_rationale.finite_bounds: The 1.0 uptake and route maxima are finite safety ceilings, while the 3.0 sink maxima equal the sum of three route ceilings; none is empirically calibrated.
design_rationale.objective: The biomass coefficient 1.0 selects the only optimization objective without assigning empirical weight.
design_rationale.cache_tolerance: The 1e-5 M tolerance is the approved deterministic cache-bin width for this architecture, not a biological threshold.

units.reaction_flux: Exchange and route fluxes are mol glucose-equivalent monomer / gDW / s; biomass pseudo-flux is a specific growth rate in 1/s; acetate export is mol glucose-equivalent / gDW / s. These are reduced bookkeeping units, not a claim of dimensional GEM rigor.

finite_bound_semantics: All bounds are finite model safety maxima; no value represents mathematical infinity or an empirical rate limit.

analytical_reference.condition: Each uptake reaction fixed at its finite model maximum of 1.0.
analytical_reference.statement: Deterministic bookkeeping consequence of this reduced topology; not an empirical prediction.
